course.title: MPharm Pharmacy (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester
quotes: Duration: 4 years Year of entry: 2027 UCAS course code: B230 / Institution code: M20
A-level AAB including Chemistry, either Mathematics or Biology, and one further rigorous academic subject.

International Baccalaureate 35 points overall. 6, 6, 5 including in Higher Level Chemistry, alongside either: higher level Biology and standard level Mathematics, or; higher level Mathematics and standard level Biology.
IELTS Academic or IELTS UKVI grade 7 (with no component less than 6.5) or;
Tuition fees for home students will be £10,050 for the 2027/28 academic year.

Tuition fees for international students will be £34,800 for the 2027/28 academic year. For subsequent academic years, the University reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year
Selection for interview is normally based on predicted grades matching the entry requirement (i.e. AAB).
